title: GPT-5.1: A smarter, more conversational ChatGPT
summary: We’re upgrading the GPT-5 series with warmer, more capable models and new ways to customize ChatGPT’s tone and style. GPT-5.1 starts rolling out today to paid users.
body: We’re upgrading the GPT-5 series with warmer, more capable models and new ways to customize ChatGPT’s tone and style. GPT-5.1 starts rolling out today to paid users.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布升级GPT-5系列模型，推出GPT-5.1版本。新模型在对话能力上更具人性化，并支持用户自定义模型的语气与风格，目前已向付费用户推送。原始信息显示：We’re upgrading the GPT-5 series with warmer, more capable models and new ways to customize ChatGPT’s tone and style. GPT-5.1 starts rolling out today to paid users.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“GPT-5.1: A smarter, more conversational ChatGPT”。其重要性主要体现在：GPT-5.1系列模型的推出标志着模型交互体验的进一步升级。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
